sourceRefs.locator: 22 October 2006. Ballot question, voting and turnout tables and project footnote. 705,284 yes, 201,105 no, 9,967 blank and 7,673 invalid; 924,029 ballots, 2,132,842 registered. The printed 76.3% uses all ballots. The yes/no subtotal of 906,389 gives 77.8% yes.

Title XV, Chapter 1, Article 325, first, third and fourth paragraphs. A proposal for a third set of locks requires executive and legislative approval, then a national referendum at least three months after legislative approval.

24 April 2006. Section 1, p. 3 and fig. 1, two existing lanes, new locks at both ends, channels and maximum lake level. Section 5.6, pp. 47–48, fig. 32 and note 78, gravity, three basins per chamber, 60% reuse within the new system and projected 7% less water per transit than the old locks. Section 7, p. 53, proposal using existing reservoirs.

Report RL30981, updated 16 November 2006, pp. CRS-15–16, “Canal Expansion Project”. Torrijos on revenue for social programmes and the Coordinadora Campesina Contra los Embalses on the risk of displacement. These are arguments put forward during the campaign.
Opening three paragraphs. Identifies the flag site outside the Administration Building and distinguishes the anniversary ceremony of 2019 from the transfer at noon on 31 December 1999.

The Canal Record, vol. V, no. 15, 6 December 1911, pp. 120–121. First column on the expected removal of the railway and dwellings already being taken down. The entries for Gatun, Bohio and Frijoles list the produce trade, housing, school and shops, 1908 counts and the burial of old Gatun under the dam. The editorial assessment of the losses occurs on p. 120.
Announcement, 5 February 2016, paragraphs on the basins at Agua Clara and Cocolí and reuse of water from Gatún Lake per lockage.
23 March 2016. Paragraphs describing two training lakes, a reproduction of Culebra Cut, the 1:25 models used by pilots and tug captains, the Maersk Edinburgh model, and wave and wind generators.

20 June 2016, first two paragraphs. Identifies the successful Pacific-side trial by the US-built crane ship Oceanus and names pilots Fernando Jaén and Ricardo Varela. The commercial inauguration was still six days away.

1 January 2020. Opening announcement and biographical section “About Mrs. Ilya Espino de Marotta”. The only woman engineer at the shipyard in 1985; resources management and project controls; engineering leadership of the expansion; first woman deputy administrator.

29 April 2016, paragraphs identifying the two participating lines and their ships Andronikos and Thalatta, the venue, the notary, Jorge Quijano, the drawing of the two names and the selected ship’s length and beam.

30 April 2016. Opening paragraphs describe the previous morning’s draw in the rotunda using the national lottery urn. Reporter names Margarita Azucena, notary Víctor Aldana Aparicio and administrator Jorge Quijano, and identifies both ships.

Morning dispatch, 26 June 2016. Opening paragraphs identify the vessel formerly named Andronikos, departure from Piraeus and the start at Agua Clara; the Pacific-side passage was still expected as this was written.

Final communiqué, 26 June 2016, paragraph beginning “The inaugural transit began”. Records a completed passage from Agua Clara on the Atlantic to Cocolí on the Pacific by Cosco Shipping Panama, bound for Asia.

Spanish section, pp. 29–30, “Crónica de un día inolvidable”, arrivals by bus, crowd at noon, entry at about 3 p.m. and ship’s horn at Cocolí. P. 53, training and chartered Baroque. English section, p. 191, completed inauguration and more than 200 transits through September; p. 193, Baroque and Oceanus trials.
Opening paragraphs on the 7 January 1914 completion of a staged crossing by the old French crane boat Alexandre La Valley and the inauguration with John A. Constantine serving as pilot aboard Ancon.

Chairman’s message, opening paragraph on 1 October 2023 to 30 September 2024. Printed p. 22, Water Use, graph 1, 542 hm³ for drinking water, 17% of 3,124 hm³; p. 23, Rainfall, graph 2, watershed rainfall of 2,118 mm and historical average 2,660 mm; p. 24, Pilot Plan for Water Treatment, April 2024 reverse-osmosis pilot at Escobal for a projected 2,500 residents.

1 May 2024, opening four paragraphs, fig. 1 and Main findings. May–December 2023 rainfall near the Gatún catchment, lake levels, ship number and size restrictions, rising urban demand and leakage, influence of El Niño, differing station trends and insufficient evidence for attribution of observed drying to human-caused warming.

20 October 2023. Image description, on Sentinel-1 radar observations and year-colour assignment, and the Credits and Licence fields for the 1,623 × 1,623 JPEG. Blue 2020, green 2021, red 2022, with ships on Gatún Lake and offshore. CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO is an explicit licence option.

PDF p. 1, paragraph giving the lake reference point 09°10′31.7″ N, 79°54′06.4″ W, with cross-references to the national mapping institute. PDF pp. 3–5, fishery and tables 1–2, listing Escobal among the fishing communities. The fisheries figures cited there come from 2004.

summary.de: Für das Geschäftsjahr 2023/24 verzeichnet die Kanalbehörde 2.118 Millimeter Regen im Einzugsgebiet und 542 Millionen Kubikmeter für Trinkwasser. Der Punkt bezeichnet den Gatúnsee. Die ESA-Aufnahmen stammen aus den Jahren vor der trockenen Regenzeit.
summary.en: For fiscal year 2023/24 the authority records 2,118 millimetres of rain across the watershed and 542 million cubic metres for drinking water. The point represents Gatún Lake. The ESA imagery predates the dry rainy season.

summary.de: Panama stimmt über größere Schleusen ab. Zwei Lotsen erproben sie auf einem Kranschiff, bevor ein ausgelostes Containerschiff die Meere wechselt. Als Jahre später ungewöhnlich wenig Regen fällt, brauchen Schiffe und Ufergemeinden das Wasser desselben Sees.
summary.en: Panamanians vote on wider locks. Two pilots take a crane ship through on trial, and a container ship wins the right to cross first. When the rains fall short years later, the ships and the communities on the shore need water from the same lake.

description.en: A shared discovery group for the early chapters of human history. Regional period definitions and dates differ; chapters can overlap in time. Each chapter shows its own time span.

labels.en: New Ways of Living After the Ice Age

description.de: Vom Ende der letzten Kaltzeit bis zu frühen bäuerlichen Gemeinschaften. Die Kapitel vergleichen Wohnen, Sammeln, Anbau und Tierhaltung in verschiedenen Regionen. Mesolithikum und Jungsteinzeit bezeichnen regionale Entwicklungen mit unterschiedlichen Zeitgrenzen.
description.en: From the end of the last glacial period to early farming communities. The chapters compare dwelling, foraging, cultivation and herding across regions. The Mesolithic and Neolithic describe regional developments with different time boundaries.

sourceRefs.locator: Chapters X–XI. Witmar as a witness, loss of the books en route, permission to preach, captive Christians, Herigar and his church. The narrative is used for the visit. Modern site identification follows the Swedish History Museum.
Opening paragraphs. Rimbert wrote about 865–875. The museum dates Ansgar and Witmar’s first journey to 830 and distinguishes it from Ansgar’s later visit.
Handelsplatsen Birka. Björkö stood at a Baltic inlet at the time of the trading settlement. The present lake resulted from land uplift. Also explains the deposits called Svarta jorden.
Geographical data, component 555-001, Birka on Björkö (not 555-002, Hovgården). A rounded site point is shared by the harbour, burial and hoard stations.
Object 106842_HST, accession 34000, Bj 515. Find context, excavator, 1877, silver and glass. The 2021 exhibition label gives the proposed reading of the Arabic inscription.

Scanning 37, pp. 131–137. Materials, p. 132 and supplementary fig. S1, for burial layout, oval brooches, clothes, position and approximate date. Results and figs. 1–3 for filing marks and composition. Discussion accompanying fig. 4 for the favoured dedication and the conditional reading “God willing” if a missing stroke is supplied.
Media ID ba934209-835b-4b3c-ab7a-73126a4375a9, direct association with object 106842_HST, named photographer and CC BY 4.0 licence.

Section Rūs, paragraphs 74–78 and pp. 27–29. Merchants at the Itil, houses on the bank, enslaved women, sable pelts, offerings and hoped-for buyer. The translation indicates where Yāqūt’s quotations parallel the Mashhad recension.
The Journey of Ibn Fadlan, 921–922, map. Pages 25–26, The reading of the caliph’s letter, for the embassy’s arrival in May 922. The market on the Volga, p. 40.
Introduction and annotated translation of the Rūsiyyah passage. The identification of the group seen by the envoy allows more than one interpretation.
Component 981-001, N54°58′44″ E49°03′23″. A regional point on the middle Volga. The archaeological site gives geographic orientation only.

Transactions 23, p. 60, description of the 1872 Birka hoard and the al-Maṣṣīṣa issue dated 963/64 by the author. Also the Volga Bulgar attributions. Pages 73–75 discuss the Byzantine frontier, the capture of al-Maṣṣīṣa in 965, service and payment as possible contexts.

Adelsö, no. 16B, SHM/KMK 5208:3. Wärner found the dish on 18 September 1872. Quotes Stolpe’s excavation notes with depth and counts of whole and broken coins. Lists al-Masisah, 963–967, and a second broadly dated late issue.
Report on the silver hoard, especially the inventory and discussion of Tornberg’s readings. Compares the readings 963 and 967 and distinguishes minting from the unknown date of burial.

Toponym entry 1443. Modern name Yakapınar (Misis), Barrington Atlas 67 B3, Pleiades 658538 and discussion of the settlement by the Pyramos. The city marks the district of production. The position of the coin workshop is unknown.

Opening description of the 1872 iron dish and uncertainty of its precise findspot. Paragraph on the larger 1991 find with seven weights. Sections on coin pendants and the two wave lines under the ship on the Hedeby coin from grave Bj 526.

labels.de: Ein Ring und ein Dirham in Birka
labels.en: A ring and a dirham at Birka

labels.de: um 830 · Ansgar und Witmar erreichen den Hafen
labels.en: around 830 · Ansgar and Witmar reach the harbour

summary.de: Rimbert schildert die Ankunft der beiden Mönche, die Gefangenen und den Ortsvorsteher Hergeir. Der Punkt bezeichnet die Handelsstadt auf Björkö.
summary.en: Rimbert recounts the monks’ arrival and describes captives and the town’s reeve, Hergeir. The point marks the trading settlement on Björkö.

labels.de: 9. Jahrhundert, wohl um 850 · Ein Ring kommt in Grab Bj 515
labels.en: ninth century, probably around 850 · A ring is placed in grave Bj 515

summary.de: Stolpes Grabungsdokumentation verzeichnet den Ring neben einer Schere. Die Gewandspangen stützen eine Datierung um die Mitte des 9. Jahrhunderts. Die Karte zeigt Birka, das Grab lag nördlich der Befestigung.
summary.en: Stolpe’s excavation record places the ring beside a pair of scissors. The brooch types suggest a date around the middle of the ninth century. The map marks Birka. The grave lay north of its fortress.

labels.de: 922 · Ibn Faḍlān begegnet den Rūs an der Wolga
labels.en: 922 · Ibn Faḍlān meets the Rūs on the Volga

summary.de: Der Gesandte beschreibt Verkäufer und versklavte Frauen an einem Ufer der mittleren Wolga. Der Punkt bei Bolgar zeigt die Region. Der genaue Anlegeplatz ist unbekannt.
summary.en: The envoy describes sellers and enslaved women on the middle Volga. The point at Bolgar represents the region. The exact landing is unknown.

labels.de: 963–967 · Ein Dirham aus der Münzstadt al-Maṣṣīṣa
labels.en: 963–967 · A dirham from the mint town of al-Maṣṣīṣa

summary.de: Der Fundkatalog gibt für die hamdanidische Prägung in al-Maṣṣīṣa 963–967 an. Androshchuk liest 963/64. Der Punkt bezeichnet die Stadt Mopsuestia, in der der Dirham entstand.
summary.en: The hoard catalogue gives the Hamdanid issue from al-Maṣṣīṣa a range of 963–967. Androshchuk reads 963/64. The point marks the town of Mopsuestia where the coin was struck.

labels.de: 1872 · Wärner entdeckt den Teller mit dem Silber
labels.en: 1872 · Wärner uncovers the silver on its dish

summary.de: Am 18. September 1872 fand ein Arbeiter namens Wärner einen Teller voller Silber im einstigen Siedlungsgebiet von Birka. Das Fundjahr ist gesichert. Die genaue Fundstelle und das Jahr der Niederlegung sind unbekannt.
summary.en: On 18 September 1872 a workman named Wärner found a dishful of silver in the former settlement at Birka. The year of discovery is secure. The precise findspot and year of burial are unknown.

summary.de: Ein Ring mit arabischer Inschrift lag in einem Grab bei Birka. Ein Dirham aus derselben Siedlung führt nach Kilikien. An der Wolga beschreibt Ibn Faḍlān die Geschäfte der Rūs und die Menschen, die sie zum Verkauf brachten.
summary.en: A ring with Arabic writing lay in a grave at Birka. A dirham from the settlement can be traced to Cilicia. On the Volga, Ibn Faḍlān describes the business done by Rūs traders, including the people they brought for sale.

sourceRefs.locator: New West Indian Guide 59 (1–2), pp. 1–26. On pp. 8–10 Richardson cites Karner's letter in the Barbados Advocate, 23 January 1905, and the 1909 Weekly Illustrated Paper retrospective on recruitment by returnees. Bridgetown wharf, lighters, Carlisle Bay and the distinction between contracted and noncontract migrants appear on pp. 9–10.

Workforce recruitment, from the paragraph beginning ‘It was recognized early on’ through the separate discussions of Barbados and Jamaica. The figure of 19,900 is recruitment in Barbados. Jamaica refused recruiting and required intending emigrants to cover tax and passage. Skilled workers were among those able to pay.

Property 1376, Historic Bridgetown and its Garrison, N 13°05′48″ W 59°36′50″ and the accompanying property map. Locator for the historic town and its harbour rather than an individual 1905 boarding place.

Prologue 29 (2). Notes 1 and 2 identify Commissary manager to J. F. Stevens, 15 February 1907, and Stevens to W. C. Gorgas, 30 November 1906, both RG 185, General Correspondence 1904–14, file 2-C-55, part 1. Quotations, financial bonds, equivalent silver pay and access to facilities appear in the opening discussion of the two rolls.

Proceedings reporting Stevens's correspondence of 9 and 30 November 1906. The separate letter concerning the joint telephone and telegraph line is explicitly dated ‘Culebra, Canal Zone, November 30, 1906’ and places his office on the day of the payroll letter. The content of the payroll instruction is in RG 185, file 2-C-55.

Annex 4, Figure 1, between printed pp. 2 and 3. Overlay of the 1909 street plan labelled ‘Old town of Culebra’ on the March 1947 contours and slide limits. Approximate site on the west bank near Zion Hill. Neither the pay-car siding nor the precise 1906 office is identified on this map.

National Archives Identifier 100997804, caption 311-A on the photograph. The dated print shows staff and workers at the pay car. The NARA/DPLA item record and US public-domain statement accompany the 1,761 × 1,443 pixel file.

Scribner’s Magazine 57 (4), April 1915, p. 396 (wage rolls and European labourers) and p. 404, photograph caption ‘Pay car at Culebra, January 12, 1908’: the carriage had counters and separate entrance and exit. This is an account by the former chief engineer and then governor.

AA00016037/00101, typescript pp. 1–3 (scan files image0029–image0031). Arrival by railway at San Pablo in 1908, coal and track work, father's referral, friends at Tabernilla, January 1910 move to the Gatún spillway, railway assignments and the concrete crane. The date and location of his first shift follow the first-person text.

Interview and transcript, 17 July 2020, AA00081353/00001. At 07:27–08:46 Moore recalls her birthplace and date, at 14:52–18:00 her father's farriery in Barbados and blacksmithing in the Balboa shops and her older sister, at 23:10 the shared facilities, at 39:38 the commissary books, at 57:45–58:18 her work and at 59:04–1:00:24 Manuel's Chinese shop and credit.

Modern American History 7 (1), pp. 131–135. Opening pages, especially note 3 on the Moore oral history and the 1920 and 1930 censuses, notes 8–10 on food, domestic work and remittances, figure 1 and note 11 on Adica Moore's work. The 22 January 1965 Spillway photograph documents her later career.
La Boca neighbourhood record, Location, 8.94811° N, 79.5613° W. Modern neighbourhood locator at the Pacific entrance. No individual family's house, shop or 1910 workplace is claimed.

Biblioteca Nacional de Panamá, ‘Martes 24 de febrero de 1920’, printed pp. 341–344: strike call, itemised demands, Governor Harding's refusal to conclude an agreement with a committee. The dated chronology distinguishes the strike call and walkout from preparatory activity.

Governor's report, pp. 26–27, increases in living costs, demand for seven cents per hour, participation estimate and terms of re-employment. Chief Quartermaster's report, ‘Strike of silver employees’, pp. 135–136, commissary disruptions and volunteer replacements.

Paragraph beginning ‘El gobernador de la Zona del Canal de Panamá’, on the 24 February walkout and strong participation in Colón. Accounts differ on the overall number, for which the chapter explicitly attributes its range to the governor’s report.
TGN 7006458, coordinates 9.3500 N, 79.9000 W, Aspinwall as alternative name, historical note on the northern terminus. City-level point on Manzanillo Island.

AA00016037/00033, typescript pp. 1–3, scans image0096–image0098. Page 1 gives his Colón address and Panamanian citizenship, recalls Bajo Matachín, names Marian Cunningson and Caroline Lowe and prices their breakfast. Page 2 records 18 years as an artisan and 30 on deck, and his tally of 5,330 transits.

AA00016037/00001, scans image0003–image0004, ‘The Contest’ and ‘The Entries’, for the circular sent to fifteen newspapers, relief packages, posting deadline and anniversary. List of entrants on image0005 and image0007 includes Clarke and Simmons.

Modern American History 7 (1), pp. 127–130, especially pp. 127 and 130. The author identifies the 112 written testimonies in Box 25 of the Isthmian Historical Society collection at the Library of Congress and discusses how they were solicited and kept.

labels.en: The people who worked on the Panama Canal

labels.de: 23. Januar 1905 · Wer in Bridgetown an Bord ging

summary.de: William J. Karner wirbt im Barbados Advocate um Arbeitskräfte für die Kanalbaukommission. Später erzählen Rückkehrer in den Dörfern von ihren Erfahrungen, und am Kai von Bridgetown verabschieden Familien die nächsten Reisenden.
summary.en: William J. Karner appeals for canal recruits in the Barbados Advocate. Men returning to the island share their experiences, and families gather at the Bridgetown wharf to see off those who follow.

labels.de: 30. November 1906 · Ein Brief entscheidet über die Lohnliste
labels.en: 30 November 1906 · A letter about the payroll

summary.de: John F. Stevens weist William Gorgas an, Schwarze Beschäftigte unter bestimmten Bedingungen auf die Silberliste zu setzen. Im Schriftwechsel über diese Einteilung kommen auch die Schwarzen Abteilungsleiter und Verkäufer der Verwaltungsläden zu Wort, allerdings nur durch ihren Vorgesetzten.
summary.en: John F. Stevens instructs William Gorgas to transfer Black employees to the silver roll under specified conditions. Further correspondence records Black department heads and sales staff in the commissaries through the voice of their manager.

labels.de: 12. Januar 1908 · Der Lohnwagen und der erste Arbeitstag
labels.en: 12 January 1908 · The pay car and the first day's work

summary.de: Ein Foto zeigt Männer am Zahlwagen in Culebra. Wie unterschiedlich ihre Berufswege sein konnten, erzählt Edgar Llewellyn Simmons, der 1908 Kohle schaufelte und später in Gatún als Bremser und Weichensteller arbeitete.
summary.en: A photograph shows workers at the Culebra pay car. Edgar Llewellyn Simmons recalled unloading coal in 1908 and later working as a brakeman and switch tender in Gatún.

labels.en: 1910 · Making a home in La Boca

summary.de: Emily Amelia Lewis reist zu William Edward Griffith nach Panama. Die Erinnerungen ihrer Tochter Adica Moore führen aus der gemeinsamen Wohnung in La Boca in Manuels Lebensmittelladen und an ihren späteren Arbeitsplatz im Krankenhaus.
summary.en: Emily Amelia Lewis joins William Edward Griffith in Panama. Their daughter Adica Moore's recollections lead from the family home in La Boca to Manuel's grocery shop and her own later workplace at the hospital.

labels.de: 24. Februar 1920 · Am 24. Februar bleibt die Arbeit liegen

summary.de: Beschäftigte der Silberliste legen die Arbeit nieder. Colón ist eines der Zentren. Der Gouverneur schätzt die Beteiligung an der gesamten Aktion auf 15.000 bis 17.000 Beschäftigte.
summary.en: Silver employees go on strike, with strong support in Colón. The governor estimates 15,000 to 17,000 people joined the walkout across the canal workforce.

labels.en: 1963 · What Clarke wrote down in Colón

summary.de: In seiner Einsendung für den Wettbewerb von 1963 erinnert sich Amos E. Clarke aus Colón an Marian Cunningson und Caroline Lowe, die Jahre zuvor Arbeiter in Bajo Matachín mit Frühstück versorgten.
summary.en: Writing from Colón for the 1963 competition, Amos E. Clarke recalls Marian Cunningson and Caroline Lowe, who sold breakfast to canal workers many years earlier at Bajo Matachín.

summary.de: Ein Frühstück an der Baustelle, ein Lohnwagen in Culebra und vier Familien mit einem Waschplatz in La Boca. Arbeiterinnen und Arbeiter erzählen, was es kostete, am Kanal zu leben, und welche Ansprüche sie durchzusetzen versuchten.
summary.en: Breakfast at a worksite, a pay car at Culebra and four families sharing a washroom at La Boca. Canal workers recall what it took to make a living and the rights they fought to secure.

sourceRefs.locator: pp. 383–384, “The Franks and northern Gaul”: grave across the river from the fortifications, dress fastener, military symbolism, arms, ring and three horse pits.

p. 3, introduction: date of the burial, composition of the hoard, four illustrated pierced silver coins, examination after removal from the ground and the authors’ interpretation of the selection; Table II: mints and rulers, including Leo I at Constantinople and Julius Nepos at Ravenna.
p. 39, introduction and fig. 1 with caption: discovery by A. Quinquin, recovery by the parish chaplain, cemetery and position of the horse pits in the Saint-Brice neighbourhood.
Site 375, Excavations, Cemetery, Beads and Glass vessels: four campaigns 1983–1986, 21 horses, 11 amber beads in four graves and several kinds of drinking vessel.
Inv. 56.460, Description and Matières et techniques: inscription, costume, loss on 5 November 1831, wax impression in Ms. 609 fol. 63v, its rediscovery in 1857 and production of the gilt electrotype.
Inv. 56.449, Description, Mesures and Mode d’acquisition: gold and garnet, loop for fastening, 1.6 cm, 1.95 g, reported numbers at discovery and presentation, two recovered after the theft.
Sections “Princely tombs” and “King Childeric”: selection of grave goods by the living, limits of identification by seal and the inference of a capital from a burial.

Namur copy R6A.0608. Printed p. 96, digitised page 119: Annuli aurei, middle row; p. 322, digitised page 348: insects with and without eyes, arranged in alternating orientations. Title and imprint: Antwerp, 1655.
Catalogue essay by Olivier Latteur (January 2025), “Contenu”, paragraphs on the 1653 construction site, Chifflet’s medical career, the Plantin-Moretus edition and the Habsburg–Bourbon argument.
“Histoire du Cabinet”, “L’installation du cabinet au sein de la bibliothèque”: gallery above the rue Colbert open to visitors from 1741 and occupied until 1865.

labels.de: Um 481/482 · Ein Königsring an der Schelde
labels.en: About 481/482 · A royal signet by the Scheldt

summary.de: Im Viertel Saint-Brice liegt das Grab mit Childerichs Siegelring. Welches Jahr seine Bestattung genau hatte, bleibt offen.
summary.en: The Saint-Brice quarter contains the grave with Childeric’s signet. The exact year of burial remains open.

summary.de: Der 27. Mai ist das Datum der Entdeckung. Von den Insekten sind heute noch zwei nachweisbar.
summary.en: The discovery is dated 27 May. Two of the insect-shaped ornaments survive.

summary.de: Das gedruckte Blatt zeigt acht Insekten in zwei Reihen. Die Überschriften unterscheiden Exemplare mit Augen von solchen ohne Augen.
summary.en: The printed leaf shows eight insects in two rows. The captions distinguish examples with eyes from those without.

summary.de: Nach dem Einbruch am 5. November wird der Ring vermisst. Der Kupferstich entstand, als das Original noch vorhanden war.
summary.en: The ring went missing in the break-in on 5 November. This engraving was made while the original still survived.

summary.de: Die neuen Ausgrabungen erfassten menschliche Gräber und drei Gruben mit Pferden in der Umgebung der Bestattung.
summary.en: The new excavations recorded human graves and three pits with horses in the area around the burial.

summary.de: Ein königlicher Siegelring, durchlochte Silbermünzen und winzige goldene Insekten. Was lässt sich aus dem Grab an der Schelde erfahren, nachdem die meisten Stücke verschwunden sind?
summary.en: A royal seal, pierced silver coins and tiny gold insects. What can we learn from a grave by the Scheldt after most of its contents have vanished?

sourceRefs.locator: The Sasanian period, Naqš-e Rostam, in particular the trilingual inscription of Shapur I on the Kaʿba-ye Zardošt and its campaign narrative.
Site description and section on the Kaʿba-ye Zardošt, the Achaemenid tower facing the royal tombs.
Paragraphs on Šāpūr I, Valerian’s capture in 260 and the three versions of the inscription on resettlement.
Sasanian dynasty, Shapur’s inscription listing royal women and daily offerings for the sacred fires.
Shapur I and his wars with Rome. Final paragraphs on the seventh-century Arab conquests and the end of the dynasty.
Accession 38.40.243. Object description, dimensions, turquoise opaque glaze, date, the excavated site of Sabz Pushan, and the 1938 division of finds.
Map of Nishapur and Environs and the section on excavation of the Sabz Pushan residential quarter.
Unit 6, The City of Nishapur, introductory account and discussion of games and household objects recovered in excavations.
Masjed-e jāmeʿ, paragraphs on the separate north and south domes, their patrons, inscription date and disputed original function of the north dome.
World Heritage property 1397, map and geographic reference for the mosque as a whole.
Opening discussion of the endowment document and its later appendix. Paper, goatskin binding, checks, Arabic and Persian copies and loans of exemplars.
Opening paragraphs locate the Tabriz foundation and date the endowment deed to 9 August 1309. The surviving ruins give the approximate quarter.
Fields objectID, accessionNumber, title, objectDate, medium, creditLine, isPublicDomain, primaryImage, and primaryImageSmall identify the object and the supplied photograph.
Opening description of The Met’s Open Access initiative and its Creative Commons Zero release of images of public-domain artworks.

labels.de: Schapurs Stein und die Schreiber von Täbris
labels.en: Shapur’s inscription and the copyists of Tabriz

labels.de: nach 260 bis um 272 · Schapurs Inschrift am alten Turm
labels.en: after 260 to around 272 · Shapur’s inscription on the old tower

summary.de: Schapur I. ließ auf drei Wänden des Turms von seinen Feldzügen und seiner Familie erzählen. Die Gefangennahme Valerians datiert den Bericht in die Zeit nach 260.
summary.en: Shapur I had his campaigns and family commemorated on three faces of the tower. The account mentions Valerian’s capture in 260, which places its composition after that event.

labels.de: 10. Jahrhundert · Eine Schale aus Sabz Puschan
labels.en: 10th century · A bowl from Sabz Pushan

summary.de: Im Wohnviertel Sabz Puschan gruben Archäologen eine türkis glasierte Schale aus. Die Datierung der Keramik umfasst das zehnte Jahrhundert. Der Kartenpunkt zeigt das Gebiet der mittelalterlichen Stadt.
summary.en: A turquoise-glazed bowl came to light in the residential quarter of Sabz Pushan. The pottery is dated to the tenth century. The map locates the area of the medieval city.

labels.en: 1088 · The north dome of the Friday Mosque

summary.de: Eine Inschrift nennt Tadsch al-Mulk als Stifter des nördlichen Kuppelraums. Welche Aufgabe der damals freistehende Bau erfüllte, bleibt offen.
summary.en: An inscription identifies Taj al-Mulk as patron of the northern dome chamber. The original purpose of this once freestanding structure remains a matter of debate.

summary.de: 1309 regelte Raschid ad-Din den Betrieb seiner Stiftung bei Täbris. Ein späterer Nachtrag legte die zweisprachige Vervielfältigung eigener Werke fest. Der Punkt zeigt das Stiftungsviertel.
summary.en: Rashid al-Din recorded the workings of his Tabriz foundation in 1309. A later appendix provided for copying his works in two languages. The point marks the foundation quarter.

summary.de: Eine dreisprachige Inschrift zählt die Angehörigen eines Königs auf. Jahrhunderte später schreiben Stifter in Isfahan und Täbris Handwerkern und Kopisten andere Aufgaben zu. Aus Nischapur ist eine Schale erhalten, deren Käufer unbekannt bleibt.
summary.en: A royal inscription records a family in three languages. Later patrons in Isfahan and Tabriz set quite different tasks for builders and copyists. A bowl from Nishapur survives without the name of its buyer.

description.de: Die Kapitel zur Völkerwanderung führen durch die spätrömische Welt. Die Funde an der unteren Weichsel reichen in die römische Kaiserzeit zurück und gehören zur Vorgeschichte der Reihe.
description.en: These chapters follow the Migration Period in the late Roman world. Evidence on the lower Vistula goes back to the Roman Imperial period and introduces the earlier history of the series.

sourceRefs.locator: Page 27 and note 45 on the variable meaning of Saracen in medieval Christian writing.
Chapters 2 and 6 and conclusion on the inscription of AH 72 and its possible meaning as a foundation date.
Appendix translating the mosaic inscriptions, with introductory notes on the date and alterations to the caliph’s name. Outer and inner faces of the arcade.
Octagonal ambulatory, mosaics, vegetal ornament, the architectural setting and the patron Abd al-Malik.
Site description. City founded in 762, the gates named for four destinations, administrative buildings, central mosque and palace.
The Cambridge World History, chapter 19, 762 foundation under al-Mansur, use of contemporary testimony and later changes of residence.
Site location and profile. Rebuilding in AH 247, octagonal graduated column, uses of readings for irrigation and taxation.
Synagogue, item 3, inventory dated 1080, T-S 20.47. Schoolroom, item 2, letter T-S Ar.53.65, separately dated to the eleventh or twelfth century.
Translated letter and catalogue data for T-S Ar.53.65, including the note about the child’s writing board.
Account of the foundation of the Fatimid city in 969 in relation to the older settlements.
CUL T-S 20.47. Translation, opening dating clause and list of scrolls and textiles. Details identifies the language of the inventory as Judeo-Arabic.
Description and translation of T-S 20.47, 1r. The inventory dated 8 Tammuz 1391 Seleucid records objects owned by the Iraqi congregation and stored in the Palestinian synagogue in Fustat.

labels.de: Ein Kalif im Mosaik und ein Schuljunge in Fustat
labels.en: A caliph in mosaic and a schoolboy in Fustat

labels.de: 691/92, Jahr 72 der Hidschra · Das Jahr 72 im Felsendom
labels.en: 691–92, year 72 of the Hijra · The year 72 in the Dome of the Rock

summary.de: Ein Mosaikband trägt das Jahr 72 der Hidschra. Die historische Datierung ist sicherer als die Frage, ob diese Jahreszahl die Gründung oder die Fertigstellung des Baus bezeichnete.
summary.en: A mosaic inscription bears the year 72 of the Hijra. The date itself is more certain than whether it marked the foundation of the building or its completion.

labels.en: 762 · The foundation of a new residence

summary.de: Al-Mansur ließ am Tigris die geplante Residenzstadt errichten. Der Kartenpunkt bezeichnet das Gebiet am Westufer. Den genauen Verlauf der Ringmauern können wir dort nicht ablesen.
summary.en: Al-Mansur began laying out a new court city by the Tigris. The point marks the area on the western bank. Its ancient circular walls can no longer be traced there.

labels.de: 861 · Ein neuer Pegel auf der Nilinsel
labels.en: 861 · A new gauge on the Nile island

summary.de: 861 entstand auf der Insel ein neuer Pegel. Eine achteckige Säule machte unterschiedliche Wasserstände messbar und damit für die Bewässerung und die Steuerfestsetzung nutzbar.
summary.en: A new gauge was built on the island in 861. Graduations on an octagonal column measured changing water levels for irrigation and tax assessment.

labels.en: 1080 · A synagogue’s furnishings in an inventory

summary.de: Ein judäo-arabisches Inventar von 1080 erfasst Eigentum der irakischen Gemeinde, das die palästinische Synagoge in Fustat verwahrte. Der Lehrerbrief ist gesondert datiert. Die Karte zeigt den Standort der Geniza.
summary.en: A Judaeo-Arabic inventory from 1080 lists property of the Iraqi congregation kept at the Palestinian synagogue in Fustat. The teacher’s letter has a separate date. The map marks the site of the Genizah.

summary.de: In Jerusalem trägt eine Mosaikinschrift Spuren zweier Kalifen. In Bagdad entsteht eine Residenz, auf der Nilinsel ar-Rauda ein Pegel. Ein Inventar und ein Lehrerbrief führen in den Alltag von Fustat.
summary.en: A mosaic inscription in Jerusalem preserves traces of two caliphs. A new residence in Baghdad, a Nile gauge on Rawda Island and two documents from Fustat show how people governed, worshipped and studied.

sourceRefs.locator: Description of the Wan’an ferry and construction in 1053–1059, pointed piers and stone transport at high tide. Final paragraph on Cai Xiang’s temple.
Geographical data, component 1561rev-009 (Luoyang Bridge) and 1561rev-012 (Jiuri Mountain Wind-Praying Inscriptions).
序 (preface), arrival in 崇寧癸未 and flight after the war. 卷之四, 食店 (book IV, Restaurants), orders, bowls and wages. National Library of China, NLC892-411999008778-118945.
Kunstkamera 4 (30), pp. 6–15, especially pp. 6–8 on the preface, Meng’s arrival and his flight from Kaifeng in 1127. English abstract.
Description of ten Southern Song inscriptions, 1174–1266. Paragraphs on the winter send-offs, the summer receptions and officials of the maritime trade office.
Opening description and foundation of the Quanzhou office for maritime trade in 1087.

labels.de: 1059 · Eine Brücke ersetzt die Fähre von Wan’an
labels.en: 1059 · A bridge replaces the Wan’an ferry

summary.de: Die Granitbrücke über den Luoyang ersetzt die Fährpassage. Cai Xiang leitet den Bau, bei dem die Gezeiten helfen, die schweren Balken auf die Pfeiler zu setzen.
summary.en: A granite bridge takes the place of the ferry. Cai Xiang oversees work in which the changing tide helps position heavy beams on the piers.

summary.de: Meng kommt mit seiner Familie in die östliche Hauptstadt. Später erinnert er sich an die Speisehäuser und an die Kellner, die jede Schale dem richtigen Gast bringen mussten.
summary.en: Meng comes with his family to the Eastern Capital. His later account remembers the restaurants and the servers who had to deliver every bowl to the right guest.

labels.de: 1174 · Das älteste erhaltene Windgebet am Jiuri-Berg

summary.de: Eine Inschrift hält das Gebet für günstige Winde fest. Spätere Inschriften auf demselben Berg verzeichnen die saisonale Ausfahrt und Heimkehr von Schiffen.
summary.en: An inscription records prayers for favourable winds. Later inscriptions on the same mountain mark the seasonal departures and returns of trading ships.

labels.en: 1323 · The likely departure port of the Sinan ship

summary.de: Ein beschriftetes Gewicht und die Zusammensetzung der keramischen Ladung weisen auf Qingyuan, das heutige Ningbo. Der Kartenpunkt am Zusammenfluss steht für den Hafenbereich. Der genaue Liegeplatz ist unbekannt.
summary.en: An inscribed weight and the mix of pottery in the cargo point to Qingyuan, present-day Ningbo. The confluence stands for the port area. The exact berth is unknown.

summary.de: Eine Brücke bei Quanzhou, die Erinnerungen eines Restaurantgasts und Gebete für günstigen Wind führen vom Song-Reich zu einem Handelsschiff der Yuan-Zeit. Wo legte es mit seinen Schalen und Münzen ab?
summary.en: A bridge near Quanzhou, the memories of a restaurant customer and prayers for sailing weather take us from Song cities to a Yuan merchant ship. Where did it load its bowls and coins?

labels.en: Harappa · a seal in a courtyard

summary.de: Ein Siegel vom Hofboden zeigt Tiermotiv und Zeichen. Keramik hilft, den Fund einzuordnen.
summary.en: A seal from a courtyard floor shows an animal motif and signs. Pottery helps date its context.

summary.de: In einem Grabungsblock kamen ein Brunnen und eine mit Ziegeln abgedeckte Rinne zum Vorschein.
summary.en: One excavation block revealed a well and a channel with its brick covers still in place.

summary.de: Ein über siebzig Meter langes Becken zeigt, wie viel Raum die Stadt der Wasserspeicherung gab.
summary.en: A basin more than seventy metres long shows how much space the city set aside for water storage.

summary.de: Ein Siegel, ein Brunnen und ein großes Wasserbecken zeigen, wie verschieden das Stadtleben der Indus-Kultur war. Ansichtsfenster 2800–1900 v. Chr.
summary.en: A seal, a well and a large reservoir reveal different sides of Indus urban life. Viewing window 2800–1900 BCE.

description.de: Frühe Städte, Fernhandel und Aufzeichnungen zwischen etwa 4600 und 1800 v. Chr. Die Kapitel vergleichen zeitlich und regional unterschiedliche Entwicklungen.
description.en: Early cities, long-distance exchange and record-keeping from about 4600 to 1800 BCE. The chapters compare developments across different times and regions.

ER 1039, canon 5, Latin and translation: proceeds of gifts and fields from the king for buildings, support of priests and the poor, or ransoming captives.

summary.de: Der Punkt bezeichnet den Bischofssitz des Remigius in Reims. Die Taufe fiel auf ein Weihnachtsfest, dessen Jahr offen ist.
summary.en: The point locates Remigius’s episcopal see at Reims. The baptism took place at Christmas in an uncertain year.

summary.de: Dieselbe Schlacht wie im westgotischen Kapitel. Chlodwigs Brief wirft die Frage auf, wer nach dem Feldzug die Freilassung Verschleppter erreichen konnte.
summary.en: The same battle as in the Visigothic chapter. Clovis’s letter raises the question of who could secure a captive’s release afterwards.

summary.de: Nachdem Chlodwig in der Martinsbasilika aufgetreten war, verteilte er laut Gregor Gold und Silber in Tours.
summary.en: After appearing in the basilica of Saint Martin, Clovis distributed gold and silver in Tours, according to Gregory.

summary.de: Cyprian von Bordeaux ist bei diesem Konzil und schon 506 in Agde bezeugt. Kanon 5 nennt den Loskauf Gefangener.
summary.en: Cyprian of Bordeaux attended this council and the one at Agde in 506. Canon 5 provides for ransoming captives.

summary.de: Was konnte ein bischöflicher Siegelring für einen Gefangenen bedeuten? Briefe, der Sieg bei Vouillé und ein Konzil zeigen, mit wem Chlodwig nach dem Krieg regieren musste.
summary.en: What could a bishop’s signet ring mean to a captive? Letters, the victory near Vouillé and a council reveal whom Clovis needed to govern after the war.

summary.de: Kolumbus’ erste Atlantikreise: von Palos in die bereits bewohnte Karibik und zurück. Begegnungen, Machtansprüche und die Frage nach Guanahani.
summary.en: Columbus’s first Atlantic voyage: from Palos to the already inhabited Caribbean and back. Encounters, claims to power and the question of Guanahani.

summary.de: Fertige Perlen, Vorformen und Eierschalenfragmente zeigen verschiedene Arbeitsschritte an einem Ort.
summary.en: Finished beads, preforms and eggshell fragments reveal different stages of work at one site.

summary.de: Straußeneierschalenperlen aus Ostafrika und dem südlichen Afrika. Form, Material und Herstellungsreste erzählen auf unterschiedliche Weise von alten Verbindungen. Ansichtsfenster 50.000–14.000 BP.
summary.en: Ostrich eggshell beads from eastern and southern Africa. Shapes, materials and manufacturing traces tell different stories about early connections. Viewing window 50,000–14,000 BP.

description.de: Gemeinsamer Suchbereich für die frühen Kapitel der Menschheitsgeschichte. Regionale Einteilungen und Datierungen unterscheiden sich; die Kapitel können sich zeitlich überlappen. Ihre Zeitspannen stehen jeweils am Kapitel.
description.en: A shared discovery group for the early chapters of human history. Regional period definitions and dates differ; chapters can overlap in time. Each chapter shows its own time span.

sourceRefs.locator: Building description and closing paragraphs on the conversion of Hagia Sophia to a mosque after the Ottoman conquest in 1453.

Egerton MS 2817, one item, 1453. The catalogue describes the Greek text, the sultan’s monogram and the Arabic-script date and vizier’s signature.

Opening section, translation from the Paris Ottoman Turkish text, envoys with the keys, property and enslaved people, annual tax, bells, new churches and customs. Discussion of Lomellino’s letter and flight by sea at notes 26–30. Reprinted in Essays in Ottoman History, pp. 275–376.

Museum location and map for the watchtower of medieval Pera (approximately 41.02565 N, 28.97413 E). The tower is a landmark for the historic district on the north shore. The places where the charter was delivered, the letter written and individual households stood are not identified.

Osmanlı Araştırmaları 23, pp. 112–115, especially notes 50 and 54. Tursun Bey on applicants for free housing and wealthy individuals ordered to come. Aşıkpaşazade on recruitment by invitation followed by compulsory transfers of families.

Belleten 79/284, pp. 80–82, especially p. 81 n. 44, quoting Aşıkpaşazade’s account of artisans’ households sent from Larende and Konya and of İshak Pasha sending households from Aksaray in 1471. The chronicler explicitly relates the Istanbul quarter to these deportees.
Aksaray section, paragraphs on settlement near the Forum of the Ox and the larger extent of the historical quarter compared with today's administrative neighbourhood.

Modern Aksaray district point 41.0083123 N, 28.9502838 E, rounded for orientation. Read with the municipality’s historical description. The boundaries and houses of the fifteenth-century neighbourhood cannot be inferred from the modern one.

The Byzantine Harbours of Constantinople, pp. 19–24, figs. 2 and 4. Paper watermarks and pictorial evidence for the Düsseldorf copy’s date, Pera and Constantinople on fol. 54r, Valens aqueduct, Kontoskalion/Kadırgalimanı with basins, gate, five shipsheds and a galley.

summary.de: Mehmed lässt die Hagia Sophia zur Moschee einrichten. Was die Eroberung einer Familie in derselben Stadt abverlangte, bezeugt der gefangene Hofbeamte Georgios Sphrantzes.
summary.en: Mehmed converts Hagia Sophia into a mosque. The captive courtier George Sphrantzes records what conquest cost one family in the same city.

summary.de: Nach der Übergabe der Schlüssel regelt eine Urkunde Eigentum, Abgaben, Handel und Gottesdienst. Die griechische Ausfertigung trägt das Herrscherzeichen Mehmeds.
summary.en: After the keys change hands a charter regulates property, taxation, trade and worship. The Greek instrument bears Mehmed’s imperial monogram.

labels.en: 23 June 1453 · Lomellino writes to his brother

summary.de: Der frühere Podestà berichtet aus Pera über die überstürzte Abfahrt der Schiffe und seinen gefangenen Neffen Imperiali. Den genauen Schreibort nennt er nicht.
summary.en: The former podestà writes from Pera about the ships’ hurried departure and his captive nephew Imperiali. He gives the town but no address.

summary.de: In den Steueraufzeichnungen erscheinen die Witwe mit ihrem Backofen, der Schmied Anton und ein Gefangener, dessen Haus man eingezogen hatte. Der Punkt bezeichnet Galata, die einzelnen Baugrundstücke sind unbekannt.
summary.en: The tax register lists a widow and her oven, Anton the smith, and a captive whose house had been confiscated. The point marks Galata. The individual plots have not been located.

labels.en: 1471 · İshak Pasha resettles families from Aksaray

summary.de: Eine Chronik führt den Namen des Istanbuler Viertels auf die 1471 zwangsweise aus der gleichnamigen zentralanatolischen Stadt umgesiedelten Haushalte zurück.
summary.en: A chronicler traces the Istanbul neighbourhood’s name to households brought there by force in 1471 from the central Anatolian town of Aksaray.

summary.en: The Düsseldorf copy of Buondelmonti’s book of islands shows both shores and the shipsheds on the Sea of Marmara. The point marks the city depicted.

summary.de: Ein Hofbeamter kauft seine Frau frei, Genuesen bringen dem Sultan die Schlüssel von Galata, und die Witwe Marya Maryana erscheint mit drei Häusern im Steuerregister. Am anderen Ufer erinnert ein Viertel an Haushalte, die aus Anatolien hierherziehen mussten.
summary.en: A courtier ransoms his wife, Genoese envoys deliver the keys of Galata, and a widow called Marya Maryana appears in a tax register with three houses. Across the water, a district takes its name from families made to move from Anatolia.

summary.en: The widowed empress gives Shōmu’s possessions to the Great Buddha of Tōdai-ji. The lute and go board survive, along with a dated inventory of the gift.

summary.de: Als Shōshi im Haus ihres Vaters einen Sohn bekommt, arbeitet Murasaki an einer Abschrift ihrer Erzählung. Ihr Tagebuch berichtet, was mit einem Entwurf geschieht.
summary.en: While Shōshi is at her father’s house for the birth of a son, Murasaki oversees a copy of her tale. Her diary records what becomes of one draft.

labels.en: 1274 · A fire recorded at Hakozaki shrine

summary.en: Sources report a fire at the shrine when forces from the Yuan realm and Goryeo reach Hakata Bay. The burnt deposits excavated locally have a broader date range.

summary.en: Wooden tags from the Sinan wreck name this Kyoto monastery. They link a customer ashore to cargo shipped in 1323. The venture may have helped to finance rebuilding after a fire.

summary.de: In Nara verschenkt Kōmyō eine Laute. In Kyoto gerät das Manuskript einer Hofdame in fremde Hände. Bei Hakata überliefern Krieger, Scherben und Ladungszettel ganz verschiedene Geschichten vom Meer.
summary.en: Kōmyō gives away a lute in Nara. A manuscript gets away from its author in Kyoto. At Hakata a warrior, sherds and cargo tags preserve quite different stories of the sea.

DD Mer. 28, pp. 75–77 (Paris plot); 32, pp. 87–89, especially ll. 3–7 (Ursinus, Beppoleno, maternal estate and mancipia; original ratification dated 629–637); 41, pp. 108–110 (Iticina, probably October 632, possibly into 633); 85, pp. 216–218 (royal privilege).

pp. 353–355, particularly p. 354. Royal confirmation of Landry’s privilege, sung praise on the model of Agaune, signatories and the king’s parents.

Sections “La basilique et ses deux nécropoles” and “Naissance du monastère”. Building extensions, 1959 discovery of the grave attributed to Arnegunde, more than 200 excavated northern burials, plaster sarcophagi and Dagobert’s patronage.
Werk 2481 (BHL 2193), Beschreibung. Death of Dagobert in 639, composition by a monk of Saint-Denis between 830 and 835, and focus on his care for monasteries.
Section H, “Le roi Dagobert”: tomb monument commissioned in the thirteenth century, the soul transported in a boat and rescued by Saints Denis, Maurice and Martin.
Introduction to the royal burials and section on the Merovingian basilica. Dagobert’s burial, present-day site and the date 639 used by the institution.

Description, collection, accession number AE/II/3 (K//1/9), source, permission and image history. The Archives nationales supplied the photograph; the current 1024 × 496 image is oriented for reading.

summary.en: At Clichy the son names Saint-Denis as the burial place of both his parents.

summary.de: Ein beschädigter Papyrus, zwei Brüder und das Grab eines Königs. Wer erhielt in Paris Land, wer musste in Clichy davon erfahren und wer sang in Saint-Denis für Nanthild und Dagobert?
summary.en: A torn papyrus, two brothers and a royal burial. Who received land in Paris, who needed to hear about it at Clichy, and who sang for Nanthild and Dagobert at Saint-Denis?

pp. 10–11, 18–21: Themistius’ audience, the negotiated peace, changing positions and unresolved legal, military, fiscal and geographical details

labels.en: At the Danube – refuge, hunger and war

summary.de: Viele Menschen überquerten den Fluss. Der Kartenausschnitt bei Silistra zeigt den Schauplatz in der Region.
summary.en: Many people crossed the river. The map window around Silistra locates the setting in the region.

summary.de: Der römische Bericht verfolgt gleichzeitig die Vorgänge am Stadttor und am Tisch des Befehlshabers.
summary.en: The Roman account follows events at the city gate and at the commander’s table at the same time.

summary.de: In der Nähe des heutigen Edirne verlor das römische Heer die Schlacht und seinen Kaiser.
summary.en: Near modern Edirne the Roman army lost the battle and its emperor.

summary.de: Was das Abkommen über einzelne Siedlungsplätze oder Steuern festlegte, ist nur unvollständig überliefert.
summary.en: The terms of settlement and taxation survive only in incomplete accounts.

summary.de: Vom Gesuch an der römischen Grenze bis zum Frieden von 382. Ein Gastmahl, die Schlacht bei Hadrianopolis und zwei römische Autoren eröffnen unterschiedliche Zugänge zur Geschichte.
summary.en: From a petition at the Roman frontier to the peace of 382. A banquet, the battle near Adrianople and the writings of two Roman authors open different windows on the events.

description.de: Die Kapitel zur Völkerwanderung führen durch die spätrömische Welt. Die Funde an der unteren Weichsel reichen in die römische Kaiserzeit zurück und gehören zur Vorgeschichte der Reihe.
description.en: These chapters follow the Migration Period in the late Roman world. Evidence on the lower Vistula goes back to the Roman Imperial period and introduces the earlier history of the series.

Galápagos finches, mockingbirds and Gould

summary.de: Mit Darwin auf der zweiten Reise der HMS Beagle. Landgänge auf Galápagos, Beobachtungen und Sammlungen auf dem Weg zu neuem Wissen.
summary.en: With Darwin on the second voyage of HMS Beagle. Galápagos landings, observations and collections on the way to new knowledge.

description.de: 1801–1900. Ein kalendarischer Zeitbereich; regionale Epochen können ihn unterschiedlich gliedern.
description.en: 1801–1900. A calendar grouping; regional periods may divide it differently.

summary.en: Charred remains preserve evidence of plant processing.

summary.de: Klinge, Reibplatte, Pflanzenreste und Fischknochen ergänzen sich.
summary.en: Blade, grinding slab, plant remains and fish bones complement one another.

summary.de: Blaue Dreiecke stehen für Menschen. Der Vergleich mit Tieren hilft bei der Deutung.
summary.en: Blue triangles represent humans. Animal comparisons help interpret the measurements.

summary.de: Wie kamen Menschen an Nahrung? Madjedbebe, Ohalo II und Taforalt zeigen Pflanzenreste, Werkzeuge und chemische Spuren im Körper.
summary.en: How did people obtain food? Madjedbebe, Ohalo II and Taforalt reveal plant remains, tools and chemical traces in the body.

description.de: Gemeinsamer Suchbereich für die frühen Kapitel der Menschheitsgeschichte. Regionale Einteilungen und Datierungen unterscheiden sich; die Kapitel können sich zeitlich überlappen. Ihre Zeitspannen stehen jeweils am Kapitel.
description.en: A shared discovery group for the early chapters of human history. Regional period definitions and dates differ; chapters can overlap in time. Each chapter shows its own time span.

sourceRefs.locator: Paragraphs beginning “Alâeddin Camii’nin içinde” and “Minberin şerefesinde”. Locations of the two royal names, Quran 40:16, dated balcony inscription, joinery and openwork. Eyice presents the sequence of the two commissions as a hypothesis.
Printed p. 134, transcription and discussion of the Konya minbar inscriptions, especially note 607. The master is associated with Ahlat and the work is dated Rajab AH 550.
Site 3576. Description of the 1155 minbar and the rebuilding of the mosque in the early thirteenth century. Location, Alaettin Tepesi, with directions to the mosque at 37.873421 N, 32.492667 E.
Inscriptions, individual entries for the north and west mosque portals, mihrab dome, west hospital portal, mosque minbar balustrade and central star. Includes Arabic terms and English renderings.

Description, passages on the north and west portals, pseudo-kündekari and openwork of the wooden minbar, and the three-iwan hospital with partial upper floor. How Monument was dated, two AH 626 inscriptions.

Printed pp. 87–90, “Documents for Dating the Building”. Transcribes and locates signatures, describes the twelve-pointed star and rail on the east face of the minbar, gives AH 638 and compares opinions on the 22-line mosque charter and the loss of the hospital deed.

Printed pp. 243–244, section C, paragraph straddling the two pages, especially n. 67. The author distinguishes the original grant in Muharram 641 by Ahmed Shah and Fatma Hatun (named villages and rural holdings) from later additions in the 1519 register.

Description, layout of the entrance, west teaching iwan and winter classrooms, student cells, central pool and oculus, lower hexagonal tiles and tiled pendentives. How Monument was dated gives AH 649 and identifies the endowment instrument dated 25 Jumada I 651.

Printed pp. 435–436, section on Karatay; p. 436, table 3 and adjacent paragraphs give days of instruction, Sunni schools, salaries, first charges on revenue, and the inscriptions naming prophets in the dome supports. The discussion explicitly qualifies the astronomical interpretation.
Original image file, author and licence information. Dosseman’s 2010 photograph looks upward into the interior of the dome of the Karatay madrasa in Konya.

labels.de: In den Werkstätten und Stiftungen von Konya und Divriği
labels.en: Inside the workshops and foundations of Konya and Divriği

labels.de: 1155, Radschab 550 der Hidschra · Zwei Sultane an einer Kanzeltür
labels.en: 1155, Rajab AH 550 · Two sultans on a pulpit door

summary.de: Die Tür und ihr Rahmen nennen Vater und Sohn. Eine weitere Inschrift datiert die Arbeit des Kanzelschnitzers aus Ahlat.
summary.en: Door and frame name father and son. A third inscription dates the work of the master from Ahlat.

labels.de: 1228/29, Jahr 626 der Hidschra · Turan Melek nennt ihr Krankenhaus
labels.en: 1228–29, AH 626 · Turan Melek names her hospital

summary.de: Am Nordportal der Moschee treten zwei Herrscher auf. Am Westportal des Hospitals bezeichnet Turan Melek das Haus als Stiftung zur Heilung.
summary.en: Two rulers appear at the north portal of the mosque. At the west hospital portal Turan Melek identifies her foundation as a house of healing.

labels.de: 1240/41, Jahr 638 der Hidschra · Ein Name im zwölfzackigen Stern
labels.en: 1240–41, AH 638 · A signature in a twelve-pointed star

summary.de: Auftrag und Signatur stehen an verschiedenen Stellen derselben Kanzel. Der Stern auf der Ostseite bewahrt den Namen Ahmeds aus Tiflis.
summary.en: Commission and signature occupy different places on the same pulpit. A star on the east side bears the name of Ahmad of Tiflis.

labels.de: Juli 1243, Muharram 641 der Hidschra · Fatma Hatun und die Erträge der Dörfer
labels.en: July 1243, Muharram AH 641 · Fatma Hatun and the village harvests

summary.de: Die Urkunde nennt Fatma Hatun und ihren Sohn als Stifter von Einkünften für die Moschee. Die Datierung gilt der Stiftung. Wann das erhaltene Blatt geschrieben wurde, ist umstritten.
summary.en: The deed names Fatma Hatun and her son as donors of revenues for the mosque. The date is that of their grant. Scholars disagree about when the surviving sheet was written.

labels.de: 1251/52, Jahr 649 der Hidschra · Eine Schule unter einer gefliesten Kuppel
labels.en: 1251–52, AH 649 · A school under a tiled dome

summary.de: Erhaltene Fliesen und der Grundriss verorten die Lehrsäle, die Schülerkammern und die Öffnung über dem Hofbecken. Die Stiftungsurkunde nennt das Baujahr.
summary.en: Surviving tiles and the plan locate classrooms, student cells and the opening over the central pool. The foundation deed identifies the year of construction.

labels.de: Juli 1253, Jahr 651 der Hidschra · Fünf Unterrichtstage und Geld für Lampenöl
labels.en: July 1253, AH 651 · Five teaching days and money for lamp oil

summary.de: Die Urkunde regelt zuerst die laufenden Ausgaben und teilt den Rest den Lehrenden, dem Personal und den Studierenden zu. Die Bestimmungen geben auch die Unterrichtstage an.
summary.en: The deed assigns running costs first, then portions for teaching, upkeep and student support. Its terms also set out the teaching week.

summary.de: Ein Holzschnitzer aus Tiflis setzt seinen Namen in einen Stern. Eine Fürstin bezeichnet ihr Krankenhaus, ein Dorf trägt zum Unterhalt einer Moschee bei, und Karatays Stiftungsurkunde bestimmt, wer in Konya lehren darf.
summary.en: A carver from Tiflis fits his name into a star. A princess identifies her hospital, a village helps sustain a mosque and Karatay’s deed sets the terms for teaching at Konya.

sourceRefs.locator: U841.4 and U842.2, especially the twice-occurring longport and the phrase for the continuing presence at Duiblinn. Printed Irish text p. 300.

U841.4 and U842.2, two camps and continued presence; U870.6, four months at Ail Cluaithe; U871.2, Áth Cliath, the leaders, 200 ships and the three groups brought back as captives; U902.2 and U917.4, the defenders driven out and Sitriuc’s entry. U980.1 and U983.2, the battle of Tara and later coalitions.

T979.2, capture of Domnall Claen; T980.3–4, Tara and the subsequent siege, agreed terms, named hostage, three days and nights, and the biblical simile (folio 15a2, printed pp. 341–342). T983.1 gives the later opposing coalitions.

Section 2.1.3, “Viking and Norman Dublin”, printed p. 9, on the Liffey crossing and the pool of the Poddle. The existing point represents the Dublin area rather than a shipyard, landing or mint building.
“Dublin Your Knowledge”, pp. 86–88, map of the sites by the former black pool, proposed longphort on its south bank and explicit discussion of the debated location.
Section 2.1.1–2.1.2, printed pp. 3–4. The two placenames, proposed camp by the pool, events of 902 and 917 and changing focus around the Liffey shore at Fishamble Street and Wood Quay.

SC1365, “Summary” and “Location”; twin summits, 1974–75 excavation, fifth trench on the eastern side, bedding trench, vitrified stone and three radiocarbon determinations in the sixth to ninth centuries. Site coordinates WGS84, 55.936756 N, 4.563298 W.
“Under siege”, identification of the 870 siege of the Rock, the Dublin leaders Olaf and Ivar, and forced removals following the four-month siege.

EMAP Report 7.1, printed pp. 53–55, discussion of captive-taking, trade in enslaved people at Dublin, possibilities of domestic enslavement or onward sale, and the limits of the evidence for different destinations.

Chapter 2, pp. 7–13, property boundaries, plot and house layouts, fifteen building levels; chapter 4, p. 38, Level 4, FS 20 (Plot 2, amber) and FS 18 (Plot 5, writing tablet, carved head, coin of Eadred); p. 82 for Level 4 as mid-tenth century. Fig. 9, p. 36, grid on Plot 3, used to orient the Fishamble Street excavation area.
Excavations 1976:047, habitation area inside the banks, amber fragments and unfinished beads and pendants. These finds illustrate working at Fishamble Street more generally.

Collection overview, paragraphs on wooden pathways and property boundaries, reused ship timbers in dock walls, drains and paths; the Fishamble Street amber worker’s floor with several hundred flakes and splinters.

British Numismatic Journal 78, p. 116 table 1 and pp. 122–124. First Irish issues in the 990s and their English prototypes; p. 124 and notes 65–68 distinguish English dies used in Dublin and Hiberno-Scandinavian-style dies at York.
“Viking coinage” and preceding paragraph. The museum puts the earliest Dublin pennies under Sihtric at around 997 or 998; English and other coins were circulating earlier.

PAS FindID 147193, HESH-E20370, image 203021. The PAS description, photograph and scale identify the Long Cross type modelled on Æthelred II, moneyer Faeremin, Dublin mint and Shropshire findspot. Record date field 1000–1010; image description, author and CC BY-SA 4.0 credit on the file page.
The rulers of Dublin and mid-tenth-century York, chronology; Mark Blackburn’s chapter on the coinage, pp. 335–336, fig. 82.2, raven issue of Óláfr/Amlaíb Guthfrithsson in 939–941.

Printed pp. 183–186, keelson sample D2-4 and its final spring ring; pp. 187–189, “Parallels in Irish and English ship-finds”, esp. fig. 55 (Fishamble Street stems T357/T364 and corresponding elements of Skuldelev 2) and text on parallels in Danish-built vessels.
Opening account, dating the build to around 1042 in the vicinity of Dublin through the oak tree rings.

labels.en: 841 · The annals record a ship camp

summary.de: Die Annalen von Ulster nennen ein Schiffslager bei Duiblinn und Überfälle auf das Umland. Der Punkt verortet die Gegend des heutigen Dublin. Die genaue Lage des Lagers ist umstritten.
summary.en: The Annals of Ulster record a ship camp at Duiblinn and raids into neighbouring lands. The point marks the Dublin area. The precise site of the camp is debated.

summary.de: Amlaíb und Ímar nahmen die Festung nach einer viermonatigen Belagerung ein. Der Felsen ist archäologisch identifiziert. Die Brandspuren lassen sich nur allgemein ins frühe Mittelalter datieren.
summary.en: Amlaíb and Ímar took the stronghold after a four-month siege. Excavations locate the early defences on Dumbarton Rock. The evidence of burning has only a broad early medieval date.

summary.de: Die Annalen melden, dass Amlaíb und Ímar mit Gefangenen nach Áth Cliath kamen. Sie zählen Schiffe und nennen Gruppen von Verschleppten. Was aus den einzelnen Menschen wurde, steht dort nicht.
summary.en: The annals say that Amlaíb and Ímar brought captives to Áth Cliath. They count ships and name groups of people who were taken. Individual fates go unrecorded.

labels.de: Mitte des 10. Jahrhunderts · Eine Werkstatt in der Fishamble Street
labels.en: mid-tenth century · A workshop on Fishamble Street

summary.de: Bernsteinreste deuten auf eine Werkstatt in Haus FS 20 auf Grundstück 2. Eine Münze hilft bei der Datierung der vierten Bauphase um die Mitte des zehnten Jahrhunderts. Die Karte zeigt das Grabungsareal.
summary.en: Amber debris suggests a workshop in house FS 20 on Plot 2. A coin helps date the fourth building phase to around the middle of the tenth century. The map marks the excavation area.

summary.de: Die Annalen von Tigernach nennen den König von Leinster unter den Geiseln, die nach der Belagerung Dublins durch Máel Sechnaill und Eochaid freikamen. Der Bericht zählt auch die ausgehandelten Bedingungen auf.
summary.en: The Annals of Tigernach name the king of Leinster among the hostages released after Máel Sechnaill and Eochaid besieged Dublin. The entry also lists the terms the victors obtained.

labels.de: um 1000–1010 · Ein Penny des Münzmeisters Faeremin
labels.en: c. 1000–1010 · A penny of the moneyer Faeremin

summary.de: Der in Shropshire gefundene Penny HESH-E20370 wird dem Dubliner Münzmeister Faeremin zugeschrieben und in die Jahre um 1000–1010 eingeordnet. Die Karte zeigt den Prägeort Dublin, der genaue Werkstattstandort ist unbekannt.
summary.en: Penny HESH-E20370, found in Shropshire, is attributed to the Dublin moneyer Faeremin and dated to about 1000–1010. The map marks the mint town. The location of the workshop is unknown.

labels.de: 1042 · Die Eiche für die Maststütze von Skuldelev 2
labels.en: 1042 · The oak for the keelson of Skuldelev 2

summary.de: Die Eiche für die Maststütze fiel im Mai oder Juni 1042. Der Bau des Langschiffs wird im Raum Dublin vermutet. Zwei in der Stadt ausgegrabene Stevenstücke zeigen vergleichbare Arbeit an anderen Schiffen.
summary.en: The oak for the keelson was felled in May or June 1042. The longship was probably built in the Dublin region. Two stem timbers excavated in the town show comparable work on other vessels.

summary.de: Gefangene erreichen 871 die Liffey. Bernsteinsplitter verraten den Arbeitsplatz eines Menschen in der Fishamble Street, ein Silberpenny den Namen des Münzmeisters Faeremin.
summary.en: Captives reach the Liffey in 871. Chips of amber locate a workshop on Fishamble Street, and a silver penny preserves the name of Faeremin, a Dublin moneyer.

sourceRefs.locator: Chapter 1, pp. 9–12, especially pp. 10–11 and map 1.1. The destruction of the countryside, Orhan’s deed of 1324, Ibn Battuta’s visit in 1331–32, the capture generally dated to 1326 and the silver issue by the following year.

Printed pp. 132–135, especially pp. 134–135 and notes 23–28. The annalistic dates, predominance of AH 726, earlier proposals, and conflicting accounts by Oruç, Aşıkpaşazade, Neşri and Şükrullah of whether Osman lived to see the surrender.

Fordham Internet Medieval Sourcebook, passage on Bursa and the paragraph on Orkhan immediately following it. Compare the first-hand topographical description and the claim about the capture with the contemporary evidence discussed by Howard.

In Remembering and Forgetting the Ancient City, chapter 7, pp. 167–169, figs 7.1–7.2. The walled hill, pre-Ottoman town, hot springs, east–west expansion, sites selected by Murad I and Bayezid I, and Bursa during the succession to Bayezid.
Coordinates table for components 1452-002 (tombs on the citadel hill), 1452-001 (Orhan Ghazi complex and khans) and 1452-006 (Green complex). Representative points refer to the listed properties.
Advisory body evaluation, Description of the property, component 1 (Orhan Ghazi complex, school, bath, kitchen and later town hall), components 2, 3, 5, 6 and 8, and History and development.

Khans Area monument inventory, entries ‘Orhan Ghazi Mosque’, ‘Orhan Turkish Bath (Mirrored Bazaar)’ and ‘Emir Khan’. The door inscription recalls foundation in 1339, burning in 1413 and repair in 1417. The inn generated revenue for the complex.

Bursa architectural inventory A106, Ayrıntılı Tanımı. Windowless storerooms below, inhabited rooms with a window and hearth above, counts of rooms and the rear stable. The inventory records later restoration.
Bursa and Cumalıkızık property description. The village is identified as the waqf village belonging to the foundation of Orhan Ghazi.

Working no. TR 21, Description and How Monument was dated. Guest rooms with hearths and royal loge, portal inscription AH 822, cenotaph dated AH 824, inscription crediting the completion of decoration in Ramadan AH 827.
DOI 10.52214/uw.v32i.12541. Al-ʿUṣūr al-Wusṭā 32, pp. 387–390, figs 13–14 and discussion of the scope of the group signature, then pp. 394–397 on logistics and alternatives to an itinerant workshop.

Photograph dated 3 June 2014, Summary and Licensing. The named subject is the prayer niche in Bursa's Green Mosque. Original image 3307 × 5072, offered by its author under CC BY-SA 3.0 among other licences.

Cihannüma 12/1, p. 15, section on women acting as agents and n. 37: BOA, MŞH. ŞSC. d., Bursa 2458, A/3, fol. 345a, Jumada II 885 / August 1480. The property, neighbourhood, names, guardianship of two orphans and the form of sale.

VIII. Uluslararası Ahilik Sempozyumu, vol. II, pp. 172–173, nn. 22–23 (BŞS 4A, fol. 310, and 3A, fol. 174b): Fatma Hatun’s lease of the Doğangözü Han and Paşa Hatun’s dye-shop lease. P. 176, n. 42 (3A, fol. 345a): Nefise, Gülşah, Gülbahar and the names of the two wards.
TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi, vol. 6 (1992), pp. 20–22, especially p. 21, passage on bey‘ bi’l-istiğlâl: use, lease to the previous owner and redemption on repayment.
The history identifies the mosque as the district’s namesake; Hakkında and the map link give 40.18421 N, 29.0572042 E. Orientation in the quarter only, not the location of the house or court.
Description of the Koza Han: completion and opening on 30 September 1491, Bayezid II’s foundation for Istanbul, the two courtyards, fountain, prayer room, storehouses and stables.

Nazanin Hedayat Munroe, ‘Silk Trade and Production’, esp. opening paragraphs on taxes and scales, Iranian raw silk, fifteenth-century Bursa weaving, velvet, ecclesiastical uses of Ottoman fabrics, and the difficulty assigning unsigned works to a weaver.

labels.de: Bursa zwischen Burg, Färberei und Seidenhof
labels.en: Bursa between the citadel, the dye shop and the silk market
usually dated to 1326 · Orhan takes the fortified town

summary.de: Die Übergabe an Orhan wird gewöhnlich auf 1326 datiert. Spätere Chroniken und Kalender weichen beim Jahr und beim Tod seines Vaters Osman voneinander ab.
summary.en: Orhan’s capture of the town is usually dated to 1326. Later chronicles and calendars differ on the year and on whether his father Osman was still alive.

summary.de: 1339 ließ Orhan vor der Burg eine Moschee errichten. Einnahmen aus einem Handelshof und aus dem Umland trugen seine Stiftung.
summary.en: In 1339 Orhan had a mosque built outside the citadel. A trading inn and property in the countryside helped support his foundation.

labels.de: 1424 · Die Ausstattung der Grünen Moschee ist vollendet
labels.en: 1424 · The Green Mosque’s decoration is completed

summary.de: In der Loge des Sultans nennt eine Inschrift den August 1424 und Nakkaş Ali. An der Gebetsnische steht die Signatur der Meister von Täbris.
summary.en: An inscription in the sultan’s gallery gives August 1424 and names Nakkaş Ali. The prayer niche carries the signature of the masters of Tabriz.

summary.de: Gülşah vertritt Nefise bei einem Geschäft über 1.000 Dirham. Gülbahar handelt für zwei Waisen. Die Moschee bezeichnet das Viertel, in dem das Haus lag.
summary.en: Gülşah represents Nefise in a transaction for 1,000 dirhams. Gülbahar acts for two orphans. The mosque marks the quarter in which the house stood.

labels.de: 1491 · Der Koza Han öffnet seine Tore

summary.de: Ein Handelshof mit einem eigenen Wirtschaftshof für Tiere und Waren nimmt den Betrieb auf. Bayezid II. bestimmte seine Einnahmen für Moscheen und Schulen in Istanbul.
summary.en: A trading inn opens with a service courtyard for animals and goods. Bayezid II assigned its revenues to mosques and schools in Istanbul.

summary.de: In Bursa finanziert ein Handelshof Orhans Stiftung. Fliesen tragen die Signatur der Meister von Täbris, und im Viertel der Kavaklı-Moschee verkauft eine Freigelassene im Auftrag einer anderen Frau ein Haus.
summary.en: An inn supports Orhan’s foundation in Bursa. Tile makers sign their work as the masters of Tabriz, and a freedwoman acts for the owner of a house in the Kavaklı Mosque quarter.

description.en: A shared discovery group for the early chapters of human history. Regional period definitions and dates differ; chapters can overlap in time. Each chapter shows its own time span.

summary.en: A treaty near Margus regulated gold payments and the surrender of fugitives. Priscus’s journey and a request from Aquileia show what captivity could mean for a family.

description.en: These chapters follow the Migration Period in the late Roman world. Evidence on the lower Vistula goes back to the Roman Imperial period and introduces the earlier history of the series.

summary.en: At the Pacific dedication a resident asks for water, farmland, a bridge across the Chame and the material from people’s old houses. The original Gorgona on the Chagres is flooded.

labels.de: 8. Dezember 1915 · Goethals verlangt das Land an der Chagresmündung
labels.en: 8 December 1915 · Goethals requests the land at the mouth of the Chagres

summary.de: Goethals verlangt von Präsident Porras den alten Hafen. Der Bürgermeister und weitere Einwohner wählen im Januar 1916 einen neuen Standort an der Mündung des Río Lagarto. Im Juni beginnt der Umzug.
summary.en: Goethals asks President Porras for the old port. In January 1916 the mayor and other residents select a new site at the mouth of the Lagarto River. The move begins in June.

labels.de: 17. April 1923 · Barro Colorado wird zum Schutzgebiet erklärt
labels.en: 17 April 1923 · Barro Colorado is declared a reserve

summary.de: Gouverneur Jay J. Morrow weist die durch den Stausee entstandene Insel als Schutzgebiet aus. Im späteren Wald findet der Botaniker Paul Standley noch die Spuren früherer Felder.
summary.en: Governor Jay J. Morrow sets aside the island formed by impounding the Chagres. Botanist Paul Standley later records evidence of farm clearings in its forest.

summary.de: Unter dem Damm liegt Alt-Gatún. An der Pazifikküste wartet Nueva Gorgona auf Baumaterial. Eine Rede bei der Ortseinweihung, eine Eingabe am Chagres und ein botanischer Bericht erzählen von den Menschen an den Ufern des neuen Sees.
summary.en: Old Gatún lies under the dam. On the Pacific coast, Nueva Gorgona awaits the pieces of dismantled houses. A resident’s speech, a petition at the mouth of the Chagres and a botanical survey reveal who lived along the new lake’s shores.

summary.en: The kilns near Gangjin produce celadon vessels and glazed roof tiles. Excavated ceramics preserve evidence of the work. No particular year of manufacture can be assigned to an individual tile.

labels.en: 1323 · A merchant ship sinks off Sinan

summary.en: The ship sank between Imjado and Jeungdo in 1323. Excavations from 1976 to 1984 brought parts of the hull, inscribed tags and wooden packing boxes to light.

summary.en: A collection of Buddhist teachings is printed with movable metal type at Heungdeoksa. The surviving second volume names the nun Myodeok among the contributors.

summary.de: Ein Gesandter beschreibt einen Löwen aus Seladon. Töpfer glasieren Dachziegel, Holzkisten schützen Porzellan auf einer Seereise und eine Nonne bezahlt den Druck eines Buchs mit. Vier Arbeiten aus der Zeit Goryeos.
summary.en: An envoy describes a celadon lion. Potters glaze roof tiles, wooden crates guard a cargo of porcelain and a nun helps pay for a printed book. Four kinds of work in the time of Goryeo.
